scope: Recover changing web pages and reload with F5.

topics.title: Search or enter address
details: The web browser menu and spoken prompt now say Search or enter address. The guide and lesson use the same name. The old spoken option still works.

topics.title: Read changing sign-in pages
details: A site may change its page or code screen as the app reads it. The app now tries to read the new screen. It does not click a link or button twice.

Checks cover a security-code screen with Try another way, the next screen and its buttons. PayPal’s public sign-in page was checked without using an account. Your own PayPal verification flow still needs confirmation after this update.

topics.title: Reload with F5
details: F5 now works from the links and headings lists too. It can reload before trying to read an out-of-date page. If the browser connection had to start again, it reopens the last page address instead of reloading a blank page. Pending form approvals are cleared.
If reloading fails, the message now says the reload did not finish. It does not claim the control is ready.
